en: "Having seen the arrows impelled by the force of the bow, and the swords grasped, sharp and polished with oil;"
When that terror of death had overwhelmed you,
why indeed did you not feel trembling?
"Having seen the iron-tipped arrows impelled by the force of the bow..."
When the sharp sword, cleansed with oil, was grasped,
and that terrifying death was arrayed,
I attained vast and sublime knowledge.
Thus, having gained such knowledge, I overcame my enemies;
even before this, my life had already been surrendered.
For one who does not form an attachment to life—
“A hero might at some time perform the duty of a hero.
Thus ends the fifth Jātaka, the Arrowhead Jātaka.
